regime_context: The detector shows broad eligible participation (9 of 16 themes above the absolute-trend gate) with Oil & Gas (XEG.TO) as the narrow leader over Consumer Staples (XST.TO) by a slim margin (0.118), and no single dominant narrative. The one validated edge — absolute-trend gate as drawdown/shake-out control — is present (gate_helps=true), so eligible themes are the ones worth expressing; momentum rank and rotation timing carry no forward edge. Track record n=147 with dir_accuracy 0.313 suggests directional calls have been modestly predictive at best.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Oil & Gas (XEG.TO, durability 0.5, mixed breadth 0.357) can hold leadership over Consumer Staples (XST.TO, durability 0.81, breadth 1.0). A CONFIRMED handoff would be XST.TO overtaking XEG.TO in rank score while both remain eligible and XEG.TO's durability bar drops toward its current 0.5 — that would retire the watch and signal a leadership shift to the higher-durability trend name.

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: XST.TO is eligible, shows full breadth (1.0), 'trend' hurst tag, and the highest durability bar (0.81) among top-ranked themes — the staying-power leg per the validated absolute-trend gate. Unlike the leader Oil & Gas, it has a trend-consistent structure rather than mixed breadth, and is not crowded.
theses.dissent: The momentum rank (~0.932) is a focus lens, not alpha; the modest 0.558 hit rate and 0.313 directional accuracy on 147 calls mean the trend-continuation assumption is weakly supported — staples leadership could stall without a macro bid.

falsifier.text: XST.TO lags XEG.TO by 3% or more over any 3 consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: ZEB.TO is eligible, trend-tagged, full breadth (1.0), high durability (0.80), and not crowded — a classic trend-following, drawdown-tolerant structure on the staying-power leg. Its stable, coherent participation argues for continued inclusion over a mean-reverting name.
theses.dissent: High crowding_z (0.75) — while under the crowded flag — suggests positioning may be getting extended relative to history; no basket-level forward edge means any crowding-driven slowdown would appear as idiosyncratic, not predictable.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO loses its eligible status (score dips below the absolute-trend gate) on the next detector print.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: XIT.TO is eligible but carries the worst crowding flag (crowded: true, z=1.25) with a mixed hurst tag. Crowding is a size-down caution only — not a fade — so the lean is 'avoid' (no new overweight) while the trend gate still technically allows participation. This is skepticism, not a short call.
theses.dissent: Reflexivity — crowded leadership can persist longer than valuation implies, and the detector explicitly warns against fading the dominant theme on a crowding flag. Avoiding XIT.TO forfeits participation in a possible continuation of AI-tech flow (macro backdrop mentions ai_tech at n=7).

falsifier.text: XIT.TO no longer carries a crowded flag AND its score rises above 0.5 on the next detector print.
